item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Oil Tops $100 a Barrel as Attacks Spread Across Middle East
item.summary: Global oil prices surged despite pledges from the United States and other countries to release reserves. Airstrikes shook Beirut and Tehran, and more ships were attacked in the Persian Gulf.

item.title: Iran’s Retaliatory Strikes Appear to Be Slowing
item.summary: U.S. officials say the country’s weapons have been diminished, slowing its attacks on Gulf nations and Israel. Iran may also be holding some weapons in reserve in case the conflict is prolonged.

item.title: How Trump’s War With Iran Changed the World in a Week
item.summary: The conflict is reshaping travel patterns, energy dependencies, living costs, trade routes and diplomatic alliances.

item.title: Trump Casts a Shadow Over One of Mexico’s Deadliest States
item.summary: President Trump wants to strike cartels inside Mexico. In Sinaloa State, a cartel stronghold, some residents said they were willing to entertain U.S. intervention.

item.title: Iran’s New Supreme Leader Was Wounded Early in the War, Iranian and Israeli Officials Say
item.summary: Officials say Mojtaba Khamenei’s legs were hurt, but the circumstances as well as the extent of his injuries were unclear. He has remained out of view since being announced as leader three days ago.

item.title: Russia Says Ukraine’s Strike on Factory City Was Deadly
item.summary: Ukraine said the attack struck a key electronics plant, highlighting how it remains capable of hitting high-value targets inside Russia.

item.title: Israel Bombards Lebanese Capital in Latest Round of Strikes
item.summary: Lebanon’s health ministry said at least seven people were killed in the Beirut attacks early Thursday.

item.title: U.N. Security Council Condemns Iran’s Retaliatory Strikes in the Middle East
item.summary: In an overwhelming vote, the council backed a resolution condemning Iran. A Russian proposal calling for an end to the war that didn’t assign blame or even name the parties, was rejected.

item.title: U.S. to Release 172 Million Barrels of Oil From Strategic Reserves, Energy Dept. Says
item.summary: The move aims to prevent prices from rising further because of the war in the Middle East.

item.title: Ukraine Can Now Manufacture ‘China-Free’ Drones
item.summary: The country has prioritized self-sufficiency in producing a crucial battlefield weapon, though weaning itself fully off cheaper Chinese components is difficult.
